coding.note: Claims are restricted to the abstract/introduction; later recipe choices are not coded as introductory novelty claims. Competitive performance and best-at-scale assertions are consolidated with the new-model claim. Cross-model benchmark comparisons are not element ablations. Data is PARTIAL despite stage proportions because curated and instruction sources/submixtures are insufficient to reconstruct the corpus. Hardware is reported without duration, GPU-hours or FLOPs, so compute is N. Only Parallel Prefill explicitly names a stated standard method; Sequential Prefill is merely likened to sequence parallelism.

scores_copied.quote:
When leaderboard results were unavailable, we used the best available results, either
from reported findings or our internal evaluations.

claims.quote:
We introduce Falcon Mamba 7B — a base (pre-trained) model with pure mamba architecture
design, and the first State Space Language Model (SSLM) in the FalconLLM series.
claims.claim: Introduce the first competitive pure attention-free Mamba 7B model, matching or surpassing leading Transformer and hybrid models at this scale.

claims.quote:
More importantly, with the pure Mamba design, Falcon Mamba 7B maintains constant memory cost
regardless of the context length, while providing extreme efficient inference for extreme long context
data generation.
claims.claim: Achieve efficient long-sequence inference with constant memory cost and substantially faster generation.

claims.quote:
We make the weights of our implementation of
  Falcon Mamba 7B publicly available on
claims.claim: Publicly release Falcon Mamba 7B weights under a permissive license.

data_disclosure.quote:
The curated dataset includes books, scientific publications (e.g., arXiv, PubMed),
patents (USPTO), and conversations from platforms like Reddit, StackExchange, and Hackernews.

tokens_disclosed.quote:
Falcon Mamba 7B is trained
  on 5.8 trillion tokens with carefully selected data mixtures.
